title: chat-v1 authenticated native WebSocket command

text.description: At most 480 UTF-8 bytes before normalization; reject Unicode controls, U+200B..200F, U+2028..202E, U+2060..206F, U+FEFF. Trim only outer U+0020; reject empty or all Unicode whitespace. Never interpret markup.

$comment: Server derives sender identity/name/time. Dedup key (character_id, client_message_id), normalized channel/text must match. Ephemeral accepted receipts survive reconnect/leave for advertised dedup window within one channel_epoch, not process restart.
